The '''Stardust Glider''' was a luxury [[Starship/Legends|starship]]<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" /> produced around [[3626 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.2}}</ref>, hand-crafted with the finest materials, including [[Corellian gold]] and the best [[Leather/Legends|leather]] available. The [[Dar'manda]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Bask Sunn]] ordered his minion [[Jaff (Dar'manda)|Jaff]] to buy personalized Stardust Gliders to add to his collection,<ref name="CX">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=codex|The Stardust Glider}}</ref> which he kept aboard his ship ''[[Fortune's Folly]]''.<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" /> A pair of these personalized Stardust Gliders were a matching set.<ref name="Quick">{{TORcite|type=message|Quick question|Bask Sunn}}</ref>
